field.name: min_days
field.help: The minimum number of valid working days a rider must complete in a month to qualify for the fixed salary tier. • days ≥ min_days → Fixed Salary applies • days < min_days → Per-Order Rate applies (no order adjustment) Typically 27 for a full month.

field.name: company_id
field.help: Branch company this platform config belongs to. Each branch can have its own platform rates for the same platform.

field.name: active
field.help: Uncheck to archive this platform so it no longer appears in salary imports. Historical records are preserved.

group.string: Fixed Salary (when rider meets minimum days)

field.name: fixed_salary
field.help: The monthly fixed salary paid to employees when they meet or exceed the minimum working days.

field.name: per_order_rate
field.help: Rate per completed order when the rider did NOT meet the minimum working days. Basic Salary = orders_completed × per_order_rate. No order adjustment (bonus/deduction) is applied in this tier.

field.name: min_orders
field.help: The monthly order target for the fixed salary tier. • orders > min_orders → bonus = excess × Bonus per Extra Order • orders < min_orders → deduction = shortfall × Deduction per Short Order • orders = min_orders → no adjustment Only applies when the rider qualifies for fixed salary (days ≥ min_days).

field.name: short_order_rate
field.help: SAR deducted per order below the minimum target. Example: min_orders=450, completed=430, rate=2 SAR → deduction = 20 × 2 = 40 SAR. Enter 0 if your platform does not penalise short orders.

field.name: excess_order_rate
field.help: SAR bonus per order above the minimum target. Example: min_orders=450, completed=470, rate=2 SAR → bonus = 20 × 2 = 40 SAR. Enter 0 if your platform does not pay for excess orders.

group.div:
If days ≥ min days: Basic = Fixed Salary → Order adjustment = (orders − target) × rate
If days < min days: Basic = Orders × Per-Order Rate → No order adjustment

field.name: help
field.p: Define salary rules per platform (Hungerstation, Keeta, The Chefz, etc.) — minimum days, fixed salary, per-order rate, order targets and adjustments.
